description: This file defines the RoleRepository interface for accessing Role entities in the database, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository. It includes custom methods for finding a role by name and checking existence by name.

classes.name: RoleRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Role entities, providing custom query methods for role management.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Role entity by its name, returning an Optional containing the Role if found.

methods.name: existsByName
methods.description: Checks if a Role with the specified name exists in the database.
